adjudication.rationale: Research structure, current product mappings, direct allergen authority, target repair, Ingredient Intelligence timing, focused validation, and idempotency passed the POC terminal gates.

evidence.excerpt: The complete current Bill of Fare exposes six food sections: shareables, chef's choice, fresh picks, supper selections, sides, and desserts.

The official-linked Toast store displays CODE RED 2440 in its heading and exposes complete Food and Non-Alcoholic catalogs. Its 2240 slug/address line is a vendor typo; liquor sections are out of POC scope. Item dialogs provide allergy-request modifiers and a request advisory, not a product allergen matrix.
The official current navigation advertises an extended three-course Summer Restaurant Week menu available throughout August 2026.
The visually reviewed official image lists four first courses, five main-course presentations, and two desserts for August 2026.
The official daily 5–7 PM happy-hour page lists nine small plates plus the recurring Tuesday oyster offer; alcohol-only offers were excluded.
Despite the legacy URL slug, the current official page and navigation advertise National Oyster Week for August 3–11, 2026.
The visually reviewed official flyer confirms $1 oysters August 3–11, 2026; alcohol-only shooter and bourbon promotions were excluded.
The official cocktail page includes a distinct Prohibition-Approved zero-proof panel with mocktails, Heineken 0, and bottled water; alcohol panels were excluded.
The official Code Red site identifies the Adams Morgan business, gives 2440 18th Street NW, Washington, DC 20009, and links its current menus and Toast store.
